conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, aiming for lower drawdown. Expect reduced upside potential in exchange for greater stability.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality long setup. Expect moderate drawdowns with balanced growth potential.
